name: Mutilating Hereditary Sensory Neuropathy with Spastic Paraplegia
aliases: Hereditary Sensory and Autonomic Neuropathy with Spastic Paraplegia
Mutilating Sensory Neuropathy with Upper Motor Neuron Signs

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Mutilating Hereditary Sensory Neuropathy with Spastic Paraplegia

criteria.description: Presence of progressive distal sensory loss predominantly affecting pain and temperature modalities
Evidence of spasticity and hyperreflexia in lower limbs consistent with upper motor neuron involvement
Development of painless mutilating injuries such as ulcers, osteomyelitis, and autoamputations
Positive family history consistent with autosomal recessive or dominant inheritance
Nerve conduction studies showing absent or severely reduced sensory nerve action potentials

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: progressive distal sensory loss, spastic paraplegia, and mutilating lesions
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may confirm diagnosis but is not mandatory; clinical and electrophysiological findings are key.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distal sensory impairment of all modalities

laboratory: Elevated inflammatory markers if secondary infection present
imaging: MRI of spinal cord may show corticospinal tract degeneration
X-rays showing bone destruction and Charcot arthropathy
other: Nerve conduction studies showing absent or severely reduced sensory nerve action potentials
Skin biopsy showing loss of small unmyelinated fibers

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly sensory neuropathy without spastic paraplegia
Onset usually in adolescence or adulthood
Presence of autonomic dysfunction more prominent
Pure spastic paraplegia without mutilating sensory neuropathy
Absence of distal sensory loss and mutilations
Genetic mutations distinct from sensory neuropathy genes

redFlags: Rapid progression of spasticity and weakness
Development of painless digital ulcers or autoamputations
Family history of similar neurological symptoms
references: Orphanet: Mutilating Hereditary Sensory Neuropathy with Spastic Paraplegia - ORPHA:139578
Dyck PJ, et al. Hereditary sensory neuropathies. Handbook of Clinical Neurology. 2013.
Harding AE. Hereditary sensory neuropathies. J Neurol Neurosurg Psychiatry. 1983.
